title: Understanding the organization and its context
summary: Know the internal and external issues, including environmental conditions such as climate, that affect your EMS.
evidence: Context register with issues and environmental conditions; review date.

title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
summary: Identify interested parties, their requirements, and which become compliance obligations.
evidence: Interested-party register; link to compliance obligations.

title: Scope of the EMS
summary: Define the EMS boundaries and applicability, considering activities, products and services you control or influence.
evidence: Scope statement (documented information), available to interested parties.

title: Environmental management system
summary: Establish the EMS and its processes, informed by context.
evidence: EMS manual or process description; process interactions.

title: Leadership and commitment
summary: Top management is accountable for the EMS and integrates it into business processes.
evidence: Management review records; evidence of leaders' involvement and resources.

title: Environmental policy
summary: Set a policy committed to environmental protection, compliance and continual improvement.
evidence: Approved policy (documented information), communicated and available.

title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
summary: Assign and communicate EMS responsibilities, including reporting on EMS performance.
evidence: Role descriptions or RACI, appointment records.

title: Risks and opportunities — general
summary: Plan to address risks and opportunities from context, aspects and compliance obligations, including emergencies.

title: Environmental aspects
summary: Identify aspects and impacts with a life cycle perspective and determine significant aspects.
evidence: Aspects and impacts register with criteria and significant aspects (documented information).

title: Compliance obligations
summary: Identify and have access to legal and other requirements and how they apply.

title: Planning action
summary: Plan actions for significant aspects, obligations, risks and opportunities, and how to evaluate their effectiveness.

title: Environmental objectives and planning
summary: Set measurable objectives and plan what, who, when and how results are evaluated.

title: Planning of changes
summary: Plan changes to the EMS in a controlled way.

title: Resources
summary: Provide the resources the EMS needs.

title: Competence
summary: Ensure competence of people whose work affects environmental performance or obligations.

title: Awareness
summary: People know the policy, significant aspects, their contribution and consequences of non-conformance.

title: Communication
summary: Plan internal and external communication, including what obligations require.

title: Documented information
summary: Create, update and control EMS documents and records.
evidence: Document list, approvals, retention and access control.

title: Operational planning and control
summary: Control processes linked to significant aspects, including outsourced processes and life cycle stages.
evidence: Operational controls, contractor requirements, inspection records.

title: Emergency preparedness and response
summary: Prepare for and respond to potential emergencies; test responses.
evidence: Emergency plans, drill records, incident reports.

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
summary: Monitor environmental performance with calibrated equipment and evaluate results.

title: Evaluation of compliance
summary: Evaluate fulfilment of compliance obligations at planned intervals.

title: Internal audit
summary: Run an audit program with objectives, criteria and scope; report and act.

title: Management review
summary: Top management reviews the EMS with all required inputs and records decisions.

title: Continual improvement
summary: Improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the EMS to enhance environmental performance.

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
summary: React, find causes, act, verify effectiveness and update the EMS.
